top_choice_rationale: A one-part prize for Drucker, Holst and Mojsov on the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form is a complete, independently replicated discovery arc, from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic action of GLP-1(7-36) amide through receptor biology to agonists with outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. Maturity is not in doubt, and a physiology-anchored citation fits the remit. The residual weakness is attribution (Mojsov's disputed priority, Habener and Knudsen outside the cap), but it is not serious enough to justify withholding the prize, so no award ranks below it.
